caption: The drawing shows six rectangular sections arranged in two columns and three rows on a beige background. Each section contains a geometric outline or a simple pattern drawn in fine, gray or black lines, and has a small piece of cloth attached along one edge. The cloth samples correspond to the drawn patterns in each section. In the top-left section, there is a red fabric with white, black, and dark red floral motifs. The drawing for this section shows a floral pattern with small dots. The top-right section has a yellow cloth with a regular pattern of small red and purple circles, and the sketch features a grid of dots matching this arrangement. The middle-left section contains a checkered fabric in brown and black; the drawing replicates this checkerboard pattern. The middle-right section has a pink cloth with a white floral motif, and the drawing is separated into vertical columns containing clusters of small flowers. The bottom-left section has a strip of red fabric with a white and brown floral pattern, and the corresponding drawing displays similarly spaced motifs. The bottom-right section features a brown and gray vertical striped fabric with red floral accents. The drawing includes vertical lines with floral motifs and dots matching the fabric sample. Each of the attached fabric examples is affixed to the left or right edge of the corresponding drawn section. The background of the entire sheet is an off-white or aged beige tone, and the arrangement is precise and orderly.
